subject: Re: Pilot extension + credits + commit discount request
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@equinox.energy>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@equinox.energy
Date: 2026-07-10T15:22:00Z
Subject: Pilot cadence + ask for credits and preferred commit discount

Hi Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier — the pilot has been really promising and the infra cost delta is looking favorable vs. our current provider. Procurement has a couple asks before we can move to a paid POC: one, can Redwood extend the pilot window by 30 days so we can surface latency metrics in our east-coast region; two, can you provide a promo credit to offset initial evaluation spend (~$12k)? Third, if we convert to a 12-month committed purchase in Q3, what discount can you provide off list?

We need these numbers to build the internal business case. I attached procurement’s questionnaire and a draft MPA for your redlines.

Files attached: procurement_questionnaire_eqx.xlsx, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Eqnx_v1.docx

Appreciate quick guidance — our procurement loop meets Friday.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Engineering
Equinox Energy

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@equinox.energy>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-10T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot cadence + ask for credits and preferred commit discount

Alice — great to hear the pilot is trending well.

Short answer: we can accommodate a 30-day extension and provide a promo credit. I need to get a quick internal exception approved for the combined credit + commit discount you’re asking for (we have thresholds that require leadership signoff).

Proposed terms I plan to escalate (subject to final approval):
- 30-day pilot extension (no change to current rate limit)
- $15,000 promotional credit applied to usage during the extension/pilot period
- If Equinox signs a 12-month committed spend >= $180k within 30 days of pilot close, 10% off list for the first 12 months (apply to usage billing; credits are separate)

If that direction works for you I’ll route to finance and leadership for sign-off and send a DocuSign for the MPA + commit overlay. Can you confirm the committed spend target you have in mind so I can cite it? Also confirmed I received your questionnaire.

Regards,
Connor O
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pilot cadence + ask for credits and preferred commit discount — need exec exception

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Equinox request (see thread below). Key ask: 30-day extension + $15k promotional credit + 10% commit discount for a 12-month, $180k+ commit. Procurement needs answer by Friday (2026-07-16).

Why we should approve:
- Equinox is a strategic energy customer (edge compute + market signals use-case) and their engineering team moved quickly; pilot metrics show 3x improvement in tail latency vs. incumbent in our east coast region.
- High likelihood to expand into predictive maintenance and demand forecasting if pilot converts.
- Competitive urgency: one of their other vendors submitted a counter trade with a short-term credit and faster onboarding.

Recommended authorized exception:
- Pilot extension: 30 days (no charge beyond usage)
- Promo credit: $15,000 (applied in one credit line)
- Commit discount: 10% for first 12 months on a 12-month contract with a committed spend >= $180,000
- Approval conditioned on signed MPA + SOW and DocuSign for the commit overlay within 30 days of pilot close

If approved, I’ll prepare the DocuSign package (SOW_Eqnx_v2.pdf stub attached) and route the MPA. We’ll also log the exception in the deal record (HubSpot ID in metadata).

Thanks — Connor

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-11T11:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot cadence + ask for credits and preferred commit discount — need exec exception

Connor — thanks for the write-up and the ROI rationale. I’m supportive of approving the promo credit + extension. A few guardrails from pricing/finance:
- Promo credit capped at $15k as proposed; credit must be applied within the pilot window and not used toward future overages.
- Commit discount can be 10% for the first 12 months but only if the signed contract and initial invoice are executed within 30 days of pilot closure.
- Need legal to confirm language in MPA/SOW that preserves credits as one-time promotional adjustments. Priyom, can you confirm legal review cadence and whether we need an approval from finance ops for the credit booking?

I will give final OK subject to Vivek’s signoff for discounts >8% per our escalation matrix (10% is above that threshold). Vivek — can you weigh in?

—Marissa
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-07-11T16:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot cadence + ask for credits and preferred commit discount — need exec exception

Thanks team — I approve the exception. Terms approved as written: 30-day pilot extension, $15k promo credit, 10% commit discount on a 12-month $180k+ commit if signed within 30 days post-pilot.

Please ensure:
1) The MPA has the promotional credit tied to the pilot period explicitly.
2) Finance ops is looped to book the credit properly.
3) Legal signs off on the MPA/SOW language before DocuSign is sent.

Connor — you’re cleared to send the formal MPA + DocuSign package and note this on the HubSpot deal.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
